title: Real-Life: Tennis court moved indoors
situation: You booked an outdoor tennis court at Westbridge Sports Club for this morning. When you arrive, you hear the following announcement.
script:
Narrator: Good morning, members of the Westbridge Sports Club.
Narrator: Due to heavy rain, the outdoor tennis courts are closed today.
Narrator: Your reserved court time has been moved to indoor Court Two in the Sports Hall.
Narrator: Please arrive ten minutes early, so that staff can check your membership card at the entrance.
Narrator: The indoor courts are open until nine p.m., so you can play for your full reserved time.
Narrator: Court Two has been cleaned and is ready for play.
Narrator: Thank you for your understanding.
translation:
おはようございます。ウェストブリッジ・スポーツクラブの会員の皆様へお知らせします。
大雨のため、本日は屋外のテニスコートを閉めています。
ご予約の時間は、スポーツホールの屋内2番コートに変更されています。
入口で職員が会員証を確認しますので、10分前にお越しください。
屋内コートは午後9時まで開いていますので、予約の時間いっぱいご利用いただけます。
2番コートは清掃済みで、使える状態です。
ご理解ありがとうございます。

questions.question: How can you play tennis today?
choices: Play on the outdoor courts once the rain stops.
Cancel the reservation and get a refund by mail.
Ask the coach for a private lesson at home.
Head to Court Two inside the Sports Hall.
questions.explanation: 「Your reserved court time has been moved to indoor Court Two in the Sports Hall.」より、予約した時間はスポーツホールの屋内2番コートで使う。屋外コートは大雨のため閉鎖されている。払い戻しやコーチのレッスンは本文にない内容。

title: Real-Life: Community bike repair clinic
situation: Your bicycle has a flat tire, and the brakes do not work well. You hear the following announcement from the community center.
script:
Narrator: Good morning, residents. The community center's free bicycle repair clinic is open this Saturday from nine a.m. to one p.m.
Narrator: Volunteers can fix flat tires, adjust brakes, and check gears, but they cannot repair frames or electric bicycles.
Narrator: Because there is limited space, please reserve a time slot on our website by Thursday.
Narrator: Walk-ins are welcome if there are empty spaces, but we cannot guarantee a repair.
Narrator: Please bring your bicycle along with any spare parts you already have.
Narrator: If you plan to ride home after the repair, please bring a helmet.
Narrator: Children under twelve must be accompanied by an adult at all times.
translation:
おはようございます、住民の皆様。コミュニティセンターの無料の自転車修理教室が、今週土曜日の午前9時から午後1時まで開かれます。
ボランティアは、パンクの修理、ブレーキの調整、変速機の点検はできますが、フレームや電動自転車の修理はできません。
場所に限りがあるため、木曜日までにウェブサイトで時間枠をご予約ください。
空きがあれば予約なしでも受け付けますが、修理できることは保証できません。
自転車と、お持ちの予備の部品があれば、一緒にお持ちください。
修理のあとに自転車で帰るなら、ヘルメットもお持ちください。
12歳未満のお子さんは、必ず大人が付き添ってください。

questions.question: How can you make sure your bicycle is repaired on Saturday?
choices: Bring your electric bicycle for a frame repair.
Book a time slot on the website by Thursday.
Arrive at the community center on Saturday evening.
Buy spare parts from the volunteers on Thursday.
questions.explanation: 「please reserve a time slot on our website by Thursday」より、木曜日までにウェブサイトで時間枠を予約する。予約なしでも来られるが、必ず修理できるとは限らない。電動自転車やフレームは修理の対象外。

title: Real-Life: Orchestra rehearsal location
situation: You play the violin in a youth orchestra. You hear the following voicemail from the conductor's assistant.
script:
Narrator: Hi, this is Ms. Lee, the assistant for the Riverside Youth Orchestra, with a change for Thursday's rehearsal.
Narrator: The rehearsal will not be held in the main hall, because the hall's stage is being painted.
Narrator: Instead, we will use the music room on the second floor of the community school. It is smaller, so only the string players should bring their music stands.
Narrator: The wind and brass players do not need to come on Thursday. Their sectional rehearsal will be held next Monday instead.
Narrator: Everyone should arrive fifteen minutes early, as the second-floor room has a narrow staircase and the elevator is out of service.
Narrator: Thank you, and please bring your sheet music.
translation:
こんにちは、リバーサイド青少年オーケストラの担当のリーです。木曜日の練習の変更についてお知らせします。
主ホールのステージは塗装中のため、練習は主ホールでは行いません。
かわりに、コミュニティスクールの2階の音楽室を使います。この部屋は小さいため、譜面台を持ってくるのは弦楽器の奏者だけにしてください。
管楽器と金管楽器の奏者は、木曜日に来る必要はありません。そのパート練習は、代わりに来週の月曜日に行います。
2階の部屋は階段が狭く、エレベーターも止まっていますので、全員15分早くお越しください。
よろしくお願いします。楽譜もお持ちください。

questions.question: What should you do on Thursday if you play the violin?
choices: Arrive early at the upstairs music room of the community school.
Go to the main hall at the usual time.
Use the elevator to reach the second-floor room.
Go to the community school on Monday for the sectional.
questions.explanation: 「only the string players should bring their music stands」と「Everyone should arrive fifteen minutes early」をつなぐ。バイオリンは弦楽器なので、コミュニティスクールの2階の音楽室へ15分早く行く。主ホールは塗装中で、エレベーターは止まっている。月曜のパート練習は管楽器と金管楽器だけ。

title: Real-Life: Cinema seats for wheelchair users
situation: You use a wheelchair, and you want to watch a movie this Saturday with two friends at Star Cinema. You call the cinema and hear the following recorded message.
script:
Narrator: Thank you for calling Star Cinema accessibility services.
Narrator: Wheelchair seating is located in the front row of each theater, and it can be reserved only by phone, not online.
Narrator: Please note that wheelchair spaces are limited to two per screening, and companions must sit in the seats directly next to them.
Narrator: If you want to bring more than one companion, the front-row seats next to you will be held for you only if you book at least one day in advance.
Narrator: Staff can help you to your seat, but please arrive fifteen minutes before the show to allow time for assistance.
Narrator: Please also note that accessible seats cannot be changed once they are booked, so check your schedule before calling.
translation:
スター・シネマのアクセシビリティ窓口にお電話いただきありがとうございます。
車いす用の席は、各劇場の最前列にあります。インターネットでは予約できず、電話でのみ予約できます。
車いす用の席は1回の上映につき2つまでです。付き添いの方は、必ずその隣の席にお座りください。
付き添いが複数の場合は、少なくとも1日前までにご予約いただいた場合に限り、隣の最前列の席を確保します。
スタッフが座席までご案内します。お手伝いのため、上映の15分前にはお越しください。
また、車いす用の席は一度予約すると変更できませんので、お電話の前にご予定をご確認ください。

questions.question: How can you and your two friends sit together?
choices: Phone the cinema a day ahead to reserve the seats next to you.
Book the accessible seats online on the day of the show.
Arrive at the cinema fifteen minutes after the show starts.
Ask the box office to hold extra seats on the day.
questions.explanation: 「can be reserved only by phone」と「the front-row seats next to you will be held for you only if you book at least one day in advance」をつなぐ。電話で少なくとも1日前までに予約すれば、隣の席を確保できる。オンライン予約や当日の追加席は確保できない。

title: Real-Life: Rescheduled hospital appointment
situation: You have a hospital appointment on Tuesday. You hear the following message on your voicemail from Lakeside Medical Center.
script:
Narrator: This is a message from Lakeside Medical Center about your appointment on Tuesday at ten a.m.
Narrator: We first said your visit would move to Wednesday, but please disregard that change.
Narrator: Dr. Ito is now on leave for two weeks, so your appointment has been moved to Dr. Shah instead, on Thursday at two p.m.
Narrator: Dr. Shah cannot see you unless you bring your blood test results from last month, so please collect them before the visit.
Narrator: The results are kept at the laboratory on the second floor, but the laboratory is closed on Wednesdays.
Narrator: The results cannot be faxed to the clinic this time, because our system is being updated.
Narrator: Please also bring your insurance card and a list of the medicines you currently take.
Narrator: If you cannot come on Thursday, please call us to cancel your appointment before Wednesday.
translation:
レイクサイド総合医療センターからの、火曜日の10時の予約についてのお知らせです。
最初は、受診を水曜日に変更すると案内しましたが、その変更は無視してください。
イトウ先生は2週間お休みになるため、予約はかわりにシャー先生に移りました。木曜日の午後2時です。
シャー先生は、先月の血液検査の結果をお持ちでないと診察できません。受診の前に受け取ってください。
結果は2階の検査室にありますが、検査室は水曜日が休みです。
今回はシステムの更新のため、結果をクリニックにファックスで送ることはできません。
保険証と、現在服用している薬の一覧もお持ちください。
木曜日に来られない場合は、水曜日より前にお電話で予約をキャンセルしてください。

questions.question: What should you do before your Thursday appointment?
choices: Go to Dr. Ito's office on Tuesday at ten a.m.
Obtain your blood test results from the second-floor laboratory before Thursday.
Visit the clinic on Wednesday for the rescheduled visit.
Have the results faxed to the clinic this week.
questions.explanation: 最後の案内は「Dr. Shah cannot see you unless you bring your blood test results」と「the laboratory is closed on Wednesdays」。火曜の予約は医師が休暇のため変更され、水曜の受診は取りやめ、結果のファックスも今回は不可と訂正されている。

title: Real-Life: Coffee shop loyalty card
situation: You are a regular customer at Bean Corner, and you have been collecting stamps on your loyalty card. You hear the following announcement at the shop.
script:
Narrator: Thank you for visiting Bean Corner. Here is a reminder about our loyalty program.
Narrator: Every time you buy a drink, one stamp is added to your card. When you have ten stamps, you can get one free drink.
Narrator: Your card is valid for one year from the day it was issued.
Narrator: To use your free drink, show your card at the register before you order.
Narrator: Stamps cannot be added after the card has expired, so please check the date on your card.
Narrator: Thank you for being a regular customer.
translation:
ビーン・コーナーにお越しいただきありがとうございます。ポイントカードのご案内です。
ドリンクを1杯お買い上げるごとに、カードにスタンプが1つ押されます。スタンプが10個たまると、ドリンクを1杯無料でお受け取りいただけます。
カードは発行日から1年間有効です。
無料のドリンクを受け取るには、注文の前に、レジでカードをお見せください。
カードの有効期限が切れたあとは、スタンプは押せません。カードの日付をご確認ください。
いつもご利用いただきありがとうございます。

questions.question: How can you get your free drink?
choices: Present your membership card at the register before ordering.
Pay for ten drinks at the counter in advance.
Mail your loyalty card to the head office.
Download a new card from the shop website.
questions.explanation: 「When you have ten stamps, you can get one free drink.」と「show your card at the register before you order」より、スタンプが10個たまったら、注文の前にレジでカードを見せる。ほかの選択肢は本文にない内容。

title: Real-Life: Address change at city hall
situation: You moved to a new apartment in the city last week. You visit the city hall counter and hear the following conversation with a staff member.
script:
Woman: Good morning. How can I help you today?
Man: I moved to a new apartment in the city last week, and I need to update my address.
Woman: Congratulations. For a change of address within the city, you need to bring your residence card and proof of your new address.
Man: I have the lease agreement. Is that enough?
Woman: Yes, a lease agreement is fine. However, the change must be reported within fourteen days of moving.
Man: Then should I go to the post office after this?
Woman: No, you do not need to. We will send the change to the post office automatically.
Woman: You're welcome. Please take a number from the machine by the door.
translation:
女性:おはようございます。本日はどのようなご用件でしょうか。
男性:先週、市内の新しいアパートに引っ越したので、住所の変更をしたいのです。
女性:おめでとうございます。市内での住所変更には、住民カードと新しい住所を証明する書類をお持ちください。
男性:賃貸契約書があります。それで足りますか。
女性:はい、賃貸契約書で結構です。ただし、引っ越しから14日以内に届け出る必要があります。
男性:そのあと郵便局にも行くべきですか。
女性:いいえ、その必要はありません。住所の変更は自動的に郵便局に送られます。
女性:どういたしまして。ドアのそばの機械で番号札を取ってお待ちください。

questions.question: How should you update your address today?
choices: Visit the post office to report your new address.
Send your lease agreement to the city hall by mail.
Present your residence card and lease agreement at this counter.
Wait two weeks before reporting your move.
questions.explanation: 「you need to bring your residence card and proof of your new address」と「a lease agreement is fine」より、窓口で住民カードと賃貸契約書を見せる。郵便局への届け出は不要で、引っ越しから14日以内に手続きする必要がある。

title: Real-Life: Campus parking permit change
situation: You are a new student who drives to campus. You hear the following announcement from the university's parking office.
script:
Narrator: This is the Parking Services Office at Lakeview University.
Narrator: Starting next Monday, parking permits for students will be issued online only. The paper counter at the Student Center will close on Friday.
Narrator: Students who already have a paper permit can keep using it until it expires, and nothing needs to be done.
Narrator: New students should apply through the university portal. Once approved, they can print a temporary permit at home.
Narrator: The temporary permit is valid for seven days. Plastic permit cards will be given out only at the Parking Office after the first week of term, when it reopens.
Narrator: Please do not park in the reserved spaces while waiting for your card, because the fine is high.
Narrator: Thank you for your cooperation.
translation:
こちらはレイクビュー大学の駐車場管理室です。
来週の月曜日から、学生の駐車許可証はオンラインでのみ発行します。学生会館の紙の窓口は金曜日に閉まります。
すでに紙の許可証をお持ちの方は、期限が切れるまで使い続けることができ、手続きは必要ありません。
新入生は大学のポータルから申請してください。承認されたら、仮の許可証を自宅で印刷できます。
仮の許可証の有効期間は7日間です。プラスチックの許可証カードは、学期の1週目が終わったあと、再開する駐車場管理室でのみお渡しします。
カードを待つ間も、罰金が高額ですので、専用の駐車スペースには停めないでください。
ご協力ありがとうございます。

questions.question: What should a new student do to park on campus?
choices: Visit the paper counter at the Student Center on Friday.
Wait for a plastic card at the Parking Office this week.
Submit an online request through the university portal and print the temporary permit.
Park in the reserved spaces until the card arrives.
questions.explanation: 「New students should apply through the university portal. Once approved, they can print a temporary permit at home.」より、新入生はポータルから申請し、承認されたら仮の許可証を自宅で印刷する。紙の窓口は金曜に閉まり、プラスチックのカードは学期の1週目のあとでしか受け取れない。

title: Real-Life: Health screening sign-up
situation: You are a forty-five-year-old resident of Westbridge City. You have not had a health check-up for three years. You hear the following announcement at the city hall.
script:
Narrator: Westbridge City is offering free health screenings for residents aged forty and over at the community hall.
Narrator: Appointments are made by phone, and the screenings will be held on the first and third Saturdays of each month.
Narrator: Residents who have had a screening in the last two years are not eligible, but they may join the waiting list.
Narrator: Those who are eligible must bring their health insurance card and fill out a short questionnaire on arrival.
Narrator: Because only forty people are accepted per session, please register by the Wednesday before the session you prefer.
Narrator: Registration on the day is not possible, and we cannot accept online bookings for this program.
Narrator: For more information, please visit the city hall website.
translation:
ウェストブリッジ市は、40歳以上の市民を対象に、無料の健康診断を地域会館で実施しています。
予約は電話で受け付けており、健診は毎月第1と第3の土曜日に行います。
過去2年以内に健診を受けた市民は対象外ですが、キャンセル待ちの名簿には登録できます。
対象の方は、到着時に健康保険証を持参し、短い問診票にご記入ください。
1回の健診で受け付けるのは40人だけですので、希望の回の前の水曜日までにお申し込みください。
当日の受付はできず、この事業についてはオンラインでの予約も受け付けていません。
詳しくは市役所のウェブサイトをご覧ください。

questions.question: How can you join the free screening?
choices: Join the waiting list online, since you had a check-up two years ago.
Register on the day at the community hall before the session.
Send a letter to the city council by Friday.
Phone the hall by Wednesday to book a Saturday slot.
questions.explanation: 「Residents who have had a screening in the last two years are not eligible」より、3年前に受けた人は対象。「Appointments are made by phone」と「register by the Wednesday before the session」をつなぐ。水曜までに電話で予約する。当日受付やオンライン予約は、この事業では受け付けていない。

title: Real-Life: Sports day rain plan
situation: Your son is in the fourth grade at Oakridge Primary School. You hear the following message from the school.
script:
Narrator: Good evening, parents. This is Oakridge Primary School with an update on Friday's sports day.
Narrator: Our first notice said the event would be held on the main field, starting at nine a.m. Please disregard that information.
Narrator: The forecast now shows heavy rain on Friday morning, so the event has been moved to Saturday.
Narrator: However, the gym was booked for a basketball tournament on Saturday, so the event would have to be held somewhere else.
Narrator: The basketball tournament was cancelled this morning, so the sports day will be held in the gym after all.
Narrator: Please note that the start time is one p.m. on Saturday, not in the morning, because the gym is used by another group before then.
Narrator: Students should wear indoor sports shoes, not outdoor shoes, and bring a water bottle.
Narrator: Parents who would like to watch can sit in the upstairs gallery. Please arrive at the school gate by twelve thirty.
Narrator: Thank you for your support.
translation:
保護者の皆様、こんばんは。オークリッジ小学校です。金曜日の運動会についての最新のお知らせです。
最初のお知らせでは、運動会は朝9時からメイングラウンドで行うとしていました。その情報は無視してください。
予報では金曜日の午前に大雨になるため、運動会は土曜日に延期になりました。
ただ、土曜日は体育館がバスケットボールの大会で予約されていたため、ほかの場所で行う必要がありました。
大会は今朝中止になりましたので、運動会は体育館で行うことになりました。
開始時間は、土曜日の午前ではなく午後1時です。それまでは別のグループが体育館を使うためです。
児童は、屋外用の靴ではなく、屋内用の運動靴を履き、水筒を持ってきてください。
見学の保護者の方は、2階の観覧席にお座りいただけます。12時30分までに正門にお越しください。
ご協力ありがとうございます。

questions.question: What should your son wear and bring on Saturday?
choices: Wear outdoor shoes and go to the main field at nine a.m.
Put on indoor trainers and pack a water bottle.
Put on indoor trainers and pack a towel.
Arrive at the school gate by twelve thirty.
questions.explanation: 最後の案内は「Students should wear indoor sports shoes, not outdoor shoes, and bring a water bottle」。運動会は体育館で午後1時から行う。メイングラウンドの午前9時は最初の案内で取り消され、タオルは本文にない。12時30分は保護者の集合時間。
